card.name: Gradual change over time: more or less
card.fires_on: Small words or commas inside phrases describing something that changes gradually, such as needing more stimulus, attacks becoming more frequent, or a drug becoming less effective. It fires at the point where the sentence is about to say what changes over time.

modes.label: Escalating need or tolerance
modes.description: Words in phrases about needing more of something to get the same effect.
modes.example: This condition differs from tolerance, which is the need<< for>> increasing doses of opioids to maintain a defined effect

modes.label: Worsening or weakening over time
modes.description: Words after become or becomes that say something grows worse, more frequent or less effective.
modes.example: Over the course of months and years, attacks become<< more>> frequent and more intense.

modes.label: Change as time passes
modes.description: Commas or articles after phrases like as time goes by or as children get used to something.

card.plain: It marks spots where a text says that over time something needs more, works less, or stops being the same.
